subject: Action Required: Missing Purchase Order for Payment PAY-999
body:
Dear Globex Team,

We have received your payment (PAY-999) for $15,000.00 intended to cover Invoice INV-5002.

However, per Section 4.2 of our Master Service Agreement, any invoice exceeding $10,000.00 strictly requires a valid Purchase Order (PO) number. Since no PO number was provided with this remittance, we are required to hold the payment until one is supplied.

Please reply to this email with the valid PO number so we can process your payment and apply it to your account balance.

Thank you,
Accounts Receivable

subject: Purchase Order Required for Invoice INV-5002 (Payment PAY-999)
body:
Dear Globex Procurement Team,

Thank you for your payment of $15,000.00 regarding Invoice INV-5002 (Payment Reference: PAY-999).

Per Section 4.2 of the Globex Master Service Agreement, a valid Purchase Order (PO) number is required for all invoices exceeding $10,000.00 USD before payment processing can be completed.

Could you please provide the valid PO number for this invoice at your earliest convenience so we can apply the payment to your account?

Thank you for your assistance.

Best regards,
Accounts Receivable Team
